rules.statement: A break-glass principal is bound by every DENY (C2).
guards: engine:FlatEngineTest#root is a break-glass binding that permits everything but every deny

rules.statement: Break-glass bindings exist only in the platform document, bind only a principal, and must have expiresAt.
guards: engine:CompiledDocumentTest#break-glass bindings are expiring principal bindings of the platform

rules.statement: The break-glass root binding applies only to principals of the platform tenant; a root binding of any other tenant does not compile.

Break-glass is created only through the control plane: two people, a bounded lifetime, and a REQUIRED audit written first; its approval needs a REQUIRED change listener and is recorded once its digest is checked, before it is stored (RC1-30). cosec-migrate writes no break-glass binding, and a break-glass binding never replaces another binding (RC1-29).
guards: control:BreakGlassControlTest#an approval of break-glass is recorded first, and only for the candidate it approves
control:BreakGlassControlTest#its lifetime is bounded, when requested and when published
control:BreakGlassControlTest#two people create it, each step recorded first
control:BreakGlassControlTest#without a REQUIRED listener, or when it fails, nothing is created
migrate:MigrateMainTest#publish refuses a break-glass binding and writes nothing
migrate:ControlWritesTest#publish starts the revision chain and writes no break-glass binding
control:BreakGlassControlTest#a break-glass binding never replaces another binding
control:BreakGlassControlTest#a request never takes the id of a binding there is

rules.statement: A change's kind is set by its entry point: a proposal is PUBLISH or BREAK_GLASS, never ROLLBACK, EXPIRE, MIGRATE or BOOTSTRAP, and a change that creates or alters a break-glass binding needs cosec:breakglass and a REQUIRED audit whatever its kind.
guards: control:ControlReviewFixesTest#a change's kind is never its input's
control:ControlReviewFixesTest#creating or altering break-glass needs cosec breakglass and a REQUIRED audit, whatever the kind

rules.statement: The policy a live break-glass binding grants does not change while the binding lives: a change that puts it needs cosec:breakglass and a REQUIRED audit, and never checks clean.
guards: control:ControlRoundTwoFixesTest#the policy a live break-glass binding grants changes only once the binding has gone

rules.statement: A rollback is held to every break-glass rule: one that would create, alter or bring back a break-glass binding, or change the policy a live one grants, needs cosec:breakglass and a REQUIRED audit and never checks clean; one that only removes break-glass bindings needs neither and has no shadow window.
guards: control:ControlRoundTwoFixesTest#a rollback is held to every break-glass rule

rules.statement: Break-glass applies only to CoSec's own token, decided by provenance, never by a name: only a principal whose token CoSec's own verifier (`JwtTokenVerifier`) verified gets it. Never an API key, capped or not, a token another TokenVerifier accepted, nor a principal another authenticator accepted, whatever its credential is called; the method `jwt` is reserved for CoSec's token (RC1-26). A principal without break-glass matches no break-glass binding.
guards: engine:FlatEngineTest#a subject without break-glass matches no break-glass binding
runtime:TokenAuthenticatorTest#onlyCoSecsOwnVerifierMayUseBreakGlass
jwt:JwtTokenVerifierTest#onlyThisVerifiersTokensMayUseBreakGlass

rules.statement: A break-glass revoke of a binding that still grants takes the document's staging slot whatever change holds it; the holder becomes CONFLICTED. A revoke of a binding that still grants is taken from the slot only by another such revoke, and revoking the binding again publishes a READY revoke of it that stalled. A revoke of an expired binding waits like any change, and any change that may preempt takes its slot.

control:BreakGlassControlTest#revoking an expired binding waits for the slot
control:BreakGlassControlTest#a narrowing change does not take the slot of a live revoke
control:RetriedPublishTest#a revoke settles a published holder and takes its slot
control:BreakGlassControlTest#revoking again publishes a stalled revoke of the same binding
control:BreakGlassControlTest#a revoke takes the slot of a stalled revoke
control:BreakGlassControlTest#a revoke of an expired binding does not hold off a revoke
control:BreakGlassControlTest#a revoke of an expired binding does not take the slot of a live revoke
control:BreakGlassControlTest#a narrowing change takes the slot of a revoke of an expired binding

rules.statement: Only its author abandons a change that revokes a break-glass binding that still grants; anyone else, the principal it revokes included, is refused (403, or 404 for one who may not see the change). Every abandon is recorded as an ABANDONED change event; a break-glass change's abandon needs a REQUIRED change listener and is recorded there before it is stored.
guards: control:BreakGlassControlTest#only its author abandons a revoke of a live binding
control:BreakGlassControlTest#abandoning break-glass is recorded first
control:BreakGlassControlTest#abandoning any other change is recorded after, best effort

rules.source: RFC 0007 §8, §10.2 (B2 follow-up: R4-1, review F-1, F-5, F-8)
rules.statement: DELETE /break-glass/{bindingId} answers 2xx only when, after the call, the binding no longer grants on the platform document's head, whoever removed it; 404 when that head has no binding of that id and no stalled revoke of it that the caller may see holds the slot; 409 when the binding there is not a break-glass binding, live or expired; and 409 otherwise. Nothing is proposed for a 404 or for a binding that is not a break-glass binding. A revoke that ends CONFLICTED, or that the head moved under before it was proposed or staged, is made again at most three more times, and only while the binding is still a live break-glass binding. A call that loses the race to another call removing the same binding may answer 409 although the binding no longer grants; a retry then answers 404.
guards: control:ControlHttpTest#a break-glass revoke answers 200 only once the binding no longer grants
control:BreakGlassControlTest#revoking a binding the head does not have is a 404
control:BreakGlassControlTest#revoking again after a lost answer settles the revoke
control:BreakGlassControlTest#revoking an expired binding tidies it away

control:PreemptionRaceTest#a revoke whose head moves before it is staged is made again
control:PreemptionRaceTest#a revoke whose binding another writer removed is not made again
control:PreemptionRaceTest#a revoke whose binding expired meanwhile is not made again
control:PreemptionRaceTest#a revoke that keeps conflicting gives up after three more

rules.statement: A platform principal holding cosec:breakglass on the platform document requests break-glass, publishes an approved request and revokes it alone: no other control action is needed, and cosec:breakglass stands in for cosec:publish on a break-glass change only. A request refused for want of it answers 403 before the platform document is read, whether or not a binding of that id exists.
guards: control:BreakGlassAuthorityTest#cosec breakglass alone requests it, publishes what was approved and revokes it
control:BreakGlassAuthorityTest#cosec breakglass does not stand in for cosec publish on any other change
control:BreakGlassAuthorityTest#a refused request tells nothing of the bindings there are
